title: Split the cut (J/L)
text: Split the cut. Put the picture change 0.5-2 s off the sound cut. J: the next voice starts under the last picture or cover, then the picture cuts to the speaker. L: the picture changes first and the voice ends under it. Build it on the upper tracks (`premiere_edit_clips` trims one clip without its partner).
